title: Assertion: Counter Behavior After Reset
constraints: Rule 1: in the first cycle after reset is released (`$fell(rst)`), `count` must be 0.
Rule 2 (outside reset): if `en = 0` at an edge, `count` must be unchanged at the next edge. If `en = 1`, it must be the previous value + 1 (4-bit wrap).
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: `$fell(rst) |-> count == 0` must not be disabled by reset in the same cycle, so write it without `disable iff`.
Keep the width of the +1 at 4 bits so 15 wraps to 0.
